name: band
description: Status band, Log pane and Progress pane for Claude Code: draws the session's cache, context, rate and model figures above the prompt, and the event log and task checklist that base, fnd, slim and the team plugins publish; reads base, fnd, slim and the team plugins' state.

disabled.title: Hide the status band
disabled.description: true draws no band above the prompt and writes no session marker (fnd's classic context monitor speaks again); /band-log and /band-progress keep working

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto = learned from the session, else 5m; 5m or 1h forces it
